page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is an instance type belonging to the Local SSD family, engineered for I/O-intensive workloads that require integrated high-speed local disk storage. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, backed by 33 MB of L3 cache. The compute environment is paired with 64 GB of memory, representing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and includes 1919 GB of integrated local SSD storage alongside a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. There are no discrete GPUs provisioned on this configuration.

Benchmark evaluations reflect architectural tradeoffs typical of older Skylake-era Intel processors. Multi-threaded processing reaches middle-tier performance tiers, demonstrated by a PassMark CPU score of 12919.13 and a stress-ng multi-core result of 11753.77. In contrast, single-thread compute capabilities remain modest, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 937.0 and relatively lower throughput in single-threaded compression benchmarks such as gzip. Memory throughput is solid across cached operations, though uncached large-block write speeds top out at 51.45 GB/sec.

From an efficiency perspective, the primary value proposition rests on the colocation of 1919 GB of local SSD capacity directly with 16 dedicated virtual cores and 64 GB RAM. This design reduces dependence on networked block storage for throughput-heavy workflows. However, deployments demanding cutting-edge single-threaded instruction throughput or large-scale AI generation will face architectural bottlenecks.

This server type is suitable for transactional database engines, distributed caching clusters such as Redis, log indexing nodes, and data ingestion pipelines that benefit from direct access to local solid-state storage without demanding ultra-high per-core CPU speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is a local storage instance configured with 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 64 GB of system memory and 1919 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Designed without discrete GPUs, it features a 5 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate balanced multi-core execution alongside restrained single-threaded compute, registering 11.71 million Redis SET operations per second and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5851.0. The integrated local SSD eliminates remote storage latency for intensive I/O tasks, providing strong qualitative resource density for local persistence. While single-thread instruction throughput and large-parameter language model inference show clear hardware constraints, the instance offers balanced utility for operational databases, caching layers, and high-throughput data processing workflows.
